summary: Weighted minimum 1-tree yields a lower bound and vertex degrees for symmetric TSP.
description: Input is a complete symmetric cost matrix on at least three vertices, a fixed root and one weight per vertex. Return the lower bound and node degree vector.

Compute a minimum spanning tree without the root under edge costs d(i,j) plus both vertex weights, then add the two cheapest distinct root edges. Subtract twice the sum of weights. A Hamiltonian cycle has degree two at every vertex, which justifies the bound. This dense Prim implementation takes quadratic time.
